summary: Session 2 of 2 (final) for set 007 (legacy vector-cycling model removal). Removed the vector-cycling implementation from every engine module against Session 1's recorded inventory; the procedure model is now the only model. cnb/config.ly: deleted the seven cycling sequence vectors (notehead-color/-shape/-hollow/-rotation/-scaling/-offset-sequence, stem-attachment-sequence), cnb:off-key-indicator, and cnb:off-key-flag-stencil. cnb/stencils.ly: deleted the six notehead-*-modulus helpers, cnb:rotate-stencil, cnb:build-base-stencils, cnb:base-stencil-vector/cnb:get-base-stencils; the (if cnb:use-procedure-model ...) branches in cnb:get-note-stencil and cnb:get-keysig-note-stencil are now unconditional config-cache reads. cnb/stems.ly: deleted cnb:stem-attachment-modulus + the vector branch/fallback of cnb:stem-attachment. cnb/off-key.ly: deleted cnb:apply-off-key-flag and the engraver's vector arms (memq off-key-indicator acknowledger branch + keyAlterations detection else); the engraver always reads off-key-mark from the cache. cnb/noteheads.ly: cnb:handle-key-change now called unconditionally. cnb/layout.ly: accidental suppression now unconditional. Doc-only header cleanups in procedure.ly/colors.ly and the dual-model header blocks of stencils/stems/off-key/noteheads. Resolved Session 1's two open questions: (Q1 default-oval sizing) pre-scaled cnb:notehead-shape-path/-hollow-path so the default oval is stored at final size (Y-span +/-0.5 = 1.0 staff-space = 2 semitones), baking in the former vector-model 0.75 scaling and restoring the documented 2-semitone default (the 'Oval 2-024' identity) rather than editing the README; real configs register their own paths and are unaffected. (Q2 off-key-indicator) removed the flag + off-key-flag-stencil entirely (vector-only scalars the Configurator never emits) and made accidental suppression unconditional; dropped the test-unit.ly off-key-indicator default assertion (unit 287->286). CONSTRAINT 1 honored: cnb:use-procedure-model kept defined (default #t) as a permanent documented no-op so every existing Configurator export's #(set! cnb:use-procedure-model #t) line stays valid. CONSTRAINT 2 honored: the set-004 round-trip golden tests/joy-to-the-world-configurator is byte-stable (committed .svg + .harvested.json unchanged) and passes 74/74 (101 assertions); tests/joy-to-the-world likewise byte-stable. Docs updated: README (single-model note, removed off-key-indicator row + Known Issue #3 + roadmap bullet, unit count -> 286), project-plan.md (Known Issue #2 -> RESOLVED, single-model current state, deferred-scope note), configurator-coordination-backlog.md (3.1 resolved, header table flagged, new section-5 entry recording no-Configurator-action-required since the emitted set! line remains valid), CNB-LY-EXPORT-SPEC-v1_2.md (D1 rationale + Engine-Settings default #f->#t annotated engine-side; always-emit contract unchanged), INTEGRATION-TESTING.md (stale off-key/callback limitation rewritten). Q1 consequence: bare-default fixtures (c-major-scale, clef-*, keysig-*, off-key-coexistence) render back at 2 semitones (undoing Session 1's temporary 2.666), so their SVG/harvest baselines regenerated and tests/clef-custom.json's one absolute first-notehead pin reverted 15.151->14.762 (gutter delta under test stays +1.5). Verification (lightweight tier, out-of-band-or-none, no metered calls): full suites green — unit 286/286, integration 246/246 (349 assertions, 10 specs). Set 007 is ready to close.
